cards.claim: The CBSE Class XI Chemistry curriculum for 2026-27 lists Unit 1 Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry as covering the importance of chemistry, nature of matter, properties of matter and their measurement, uncertainty in measurement, laws of chemical combination, Dalton's atomic theory, atomic and molecular masses, mole concept and molar masses, percentage composition, and stoichiometry and stoichiometric calculations.
cards.quote: Unit 1: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry Importance of Chemistry, Nature of Matter, Properties of Matter and their Measurement, Uncertainty in Measurement, Laws of Chemical Combination, Dalton's Atomic Theory, Atomic and Molecular Masses, Mole Concept and Molar Masses, Percentage Composition, Stoichiometry and Stoichiometric Calculations.

locator.section: Class XI 2026-27 (Theory), Unit 1: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry

cards.claim: The NCERT Class XI Chemistry Unit 1 (reprint 2026-27) expects learners to describe mole and molar mass, calculate the mass per cent of elements in a compound, determine empirical and molecular formulae from experimental data, and perform stoichiometric calculations.
cards.quote: describe the terms – mole and molar mass; • calculate the mass per cent of component elements constituting a compound; • determine empirical formula and molecular formula for a compound from the given experimental data; and • perform the stoichiometric calculations.
